description: Edit Markdown outlines as mind maps beside your editor or in Chrome; every change is written back to the Markdown.
virtualWorkspaces: Inkmap edits Markdown files on disk.
command.openToSide: Open Mind Map to the Side
config.browser: Browser used by “Open Mind Map in Browser”
config.browser.chrome: Google Chrome (falls back to the default browser when not found)
config.browserAutoSave: Save the document automatically after editing the map in the browser; when off, changes stay unsaved in the editor
